planets.name: K2-416 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-416 with a 13.1-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: K2-416 b was found in 2023 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-416. Its orbit and size follow Incha et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
